title: Highly effective microporous and mesoporous metal–organic frameworks for effective ivermectin adsorption in water treatment and delivery systems
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13924-13939
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01662B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ola Gamal, Walaa A. Moselhy, Mohamed Taha
This study uses high-throughput screening of 14 000+ MOFs to identify top candidates for ivermectin adsorption. MD simulations reveal key mechanisms, supporting MOF selection for water treatment and drug delivery applications.
